description: National Medicine Regulatory Authority - The Medicines (Pricing Mechanism for Determination of Maximum Retail Price for a Dosage from and a Strength of a Particular Medicine) Regulation No. 01 of 2024
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing a pricing mechanism for medicines. It creates new regulatory requirements for determining maximum retail prices, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure changes. The content focuses on establishing legal frameworks and compliance requirements for medicine pricing.
